title: Capability before cost
text: So of all the different uh, models, though, well, there's so there's DeepSeek, there's Quen, there's Gemma, Google's open source models. There's all kinds of different models, and I mean, honestly, leaning on some of the open source ones, they should be way cheaper. But if they're way less capable, you know, what I've learned is that the capability of a model is almost more important than the cost. So, like. You know, it's it's better to just pay a little more and get it done properly than pay a tenth the cost and not get, you know, get a tenth the result means that like you're not getting much of anything and it may or may not be correct at all.
